_about: The VFX grammar (tools/evfx/grammar.py, `evfx grammar`, docs/vfx-grammar.md). Roles are plan §4a's (core, glint, base, volume, dark) plus an additive glow, with its sparks split in three (shards: fast, then stopped; dust: small and calm; debris: heavy, falling) and the Lotus ground layer. Per role: its job, the ways it may leave (`exits`), the range each measure should sit in ([low, high]), where the ranges came from, and `open`: the middle 70% of what openly published Roblox effects do (`evfx study`). Sizes and reach are in bodies (a character is 5 studs). Ranges from Phát's picks will win over the rest.

core.job: the white-hot centre of the hit, on for 2 to 6 frames, on top
core.source: life from Lotus, Frigid (2-frame flashes) and Genshin (2-3 frame peaks); open effects hold their glows 0.2-0.9 s, which reads as a glow, not a core; exits: Phát 2026-10-24 (a flash leaves fast, an air gust slowly; nothing vanishes whole) and Lotus's slow calm tail

glint.job: a crisp flare, star or ray fan on the hit, or a telegraph before it
glint.source: plan §4a and the references; open star sprites linger 0.5-1.5 s and spread wide, which is the dust role here; exits: Phát 2026-10-24 (a flash leaves fast, an air gust slowly; nothing vanishes whole) and Lotus's slow calm tail

base.job: the one readable silhouette of the beat: a flipbook, a ring, a shell
base.source: open rings live 0.2-0.5 s; plan §4a; exits: Phát 2026-10-24 (a flash leaves fast, an air gust slowly; nothing vanishes whole) and Lotus's slow calm tail

volume.job: fullness behind the base: smoke, glow, a wider spread
volume.source: open smoke: 0.2-3.5 s, LightEmission 0-0.16, lifetimes vary up to 6x; exits: Phát 2026-10-24 (a flash leaves fast, an air gust slowly; nothing vanishes whole) and Lotus's slow calm tail

glow.job: an additive soft disc around the core or behind a shape: light, not mass
glow.source: Lotus's violet bloom and bokeh; open glows: LightEmission 1, 0.2-0.9 s, large; exits: Phát 2026-10-24 (a flash leaves fast, an air gust slowly; nothing vanishes whole) and Lotus's slow calm tail

dark.job: value contrast: a dark halo, ink, a shadow behind the bright layers
dark.source: Lotus's dark halo; open 'Darkness' layers: 0.75-0.95 bodies, LightEmission under 0.15; exits: Phát 2026-10-24 (a flash leaves fast, an air gust slowly; nothing vanishes whole) and Lotus's slow calm tail

shards.job: direction and snap: stretched sparks that explode and stop
shards.source: plan §4a (8-16 shards, high Drag); open sparks: 0.2-1 s, reach 0.2-2 bodies; exits: Phát 2026-10-24 (a flash leaves fast, an air gust slowly; nothing vanishes whole) and Lotus's slow calm tail

dust.job: tiny points over everything for scale and sparkle; calm, lingering
dust.source: Lotus's gold dust and petals linger; Genshin sparkles vary about 2x; open dots vary 1-4x; exits: Phát 2026-10-24 (a flash leaves fast, an air gust slowly; nothing vanishes whole) and Lotus's slow calm tail

debris.job: heavy chunks thrown by the hit: normal blend, gravity, they land
debris.source: open debris (ImpactVFX and others): 0.2-2 s, Acceleration about -200, LightEmission 0; exits: Phát 2026-10-24 (a flash leaves fast, an air gust slowly; nothing vanishes whole) and Lotus's slow calm tail

ground.job: ties the beat to the floor: rings, decals, dust rings
ground.source: Lotus's ground ring and swirl; Frigid's frost sigil; exits: Phát 2026-10-24 (a flash leaves fast, an air gust slowly; nothing vanishes whole) and Lotus's slow calm tail

tell.job: a small cue in the wind-up that hands off to the hit: it gathers or glints, then is gone by the hit (motion bible: telegraph)
tell.source: the motion bible's telegraph and wind-up; Frigid's wind arcs and needle glints

structure._depthOrder: ZOffset should not decrease along this list (dark lowest, the core on top); ground, tell and shells are not ordered by ZOffset
structure._beatLayers: layers one beat stacks (Lotus: 4 to 9 per beat; a short hit 3 to 6)
